dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. A distinct, isolated oval ring is visible in the upper-left quadrant. A larger, more complex interlocking 'O' structure is present on the right-lateral side. The edges exhibit a soft gradient from high-intensity light centers to the dark surrounding pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid white punctate blobs concentrated near the dorsal midline, separate from the larger annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary upper-left annulus, the central 'C' structure, and the large right-lateral loop form a wide-angled obtuse triangle spanning the visible dorsal-lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of overlapping, high-contrast light bands create a 'chain-link' appearance where the boundaries of individual annuli merge into a continuous network.
